title: 第861章 六合魔方斩杀夺宝第860章 战洛子雲隐身法袍
content_zh:
这是一件科技法宝，跟传统法宝不同。
它由无数细小的金属四方体组成，聚合时是一个四方形魔方，散开时，这些组成魔方的细小四方体便悬浮在半空，将洛子雲围在中间，呈规则或不规则状，像将人隔绝在四维空间之外。
“这件法宝，谓之六合魔方，由沧澜古界最著名的炼器大师所铸。我就站在这中间不动，你破一万年，都破不开，信不信。”
洛子雲双手环胸，一脸傲慢地看着张扬。
张扬一剑劈落。
悬浮在半空的四方体像是感受到攻击，体表异文大盛，纷纷挡在剑芒面前。
剑芒只斩到一半，就彻底消失了。
这件法宝跟云沏的七宝玲珑塔一样，都是最顶尖的防御法宝。
只不过，七宝玲珑塔是纯防御，这是灵动防御。
这些该死的少主，身上果然都有逆天级别的防御法宝。
换在平时，张扬肯定不会浪费力气去破阵，但是一想到落天生因为这家伙而落得如此下场，他还在里面疯狂叫嚣，他就压抑不住内心的怒火。
“怎么，怕了？”
见张扬没有动手，洛子雲继续激将，“你刚才不是很狂，想要杀我吗，就这点本事？”
张扬目光落到层层悬浮的四方体上，这些四方体在遭到攻击的时候，会快速移动，来挡住剑道。
如果——它们无法移动，或者移动速度变慢呢？
“冰儿，进去将大阵冰封。”
冰灵领命，遁入阵内，只进入很浅的地方就被一股强大的威力逼退，无法再进一步。
“主人，只能这么深。”
“够了，冰封。”
冰灵身上涌起滔天寒气，周围空间急冻，瞬间便将外围的四方体冻住。

“没用的。”
洛子雲讥笑着，开始驱动大阵。
被冻住的四方体开始移动起来，厚厚的寒冰瞬间被碾碎，化成无数冰屑，从天而降。
“谁说没用？”
张扬冷哼一声，施展大风车，疯狂切割。
四方体虽然能碾碎冰层，但是根本跟不上大风车速度，在卍字印疯狂的切割之下，大阵慢慢被切开一道口子，张扬缓缓渗透而入。
“你进来，就是找死。”
洛子雲非但没有害怕，反而更加高兴——这六合魔方不但是一件防守法宝，还是一件攻击法宝。
无数细小的方块，带着强大的威压，朝张扬身上攻击。
张扬等的就是这一刻，无论是人还是法宝，在进攻之时就是防守最弱之时。
他施展冰火双龙，在阵中爆炸出的威力，比起在阵外不知道强了多少倍。
无数方块被震飞，而大阵也被炸开一个缺口。
洛子雲脸色大变，回想起送法宝之人说过，如果对方过于强大，一定要死守，别冒进。
自己犯了一个大忌。
他赶紧召回方块，想要补救。
张扬一拍灵虫袋，数百只六翼魔虫飞出，见缝插针，朝阵内渗透。
洛子雲根本没将这灵虫看在眼里，一心在张扬身上，在他看来，这些灵虫不足为惧。
殊不知，他又犯了一个大忌。
“终于到位了，吐。”
渗透进入阵中的六翼魔虫，纷纷吐出佛珠。

一颗颗佛珠在阵中亮起，生出法相。
“可恶。”
洛子雲知道已经晚了，赶紧操控大阵。
六合魔方大阵vs佛陀大阵。
两个都是逆天级别的大阵，在各自的空间渗透布阵，这一番拼的是谁的阵更厉害，谁的底蕴更强。
content_en:
This is a technological magic weapon, which is different from traditional magic weapons.
It is composed of countless small metal tetragons. When aggregated, it becomes a square Rubik's Cube. When dispersed, these tiny tetragons that make up the Rubik's Cube are suspended in mid-air, surrounding Luo Ziyun in the middle, in regular or irregular shapes, as if isolating people from the four-dimensional space.
"This magic weapon is called the Liuhe Rubik's Cube. It was made by the most famous weapon refiner in the Canglan ancient world. I will stand in the middle without moving. You can't break it even if it takes ten thousand years. Believe it or not."
Luo Ziyun crossed his hands on his chest and looked at Zhang Yang arrogantly.
Zhang Yang struck down with his sword.
The rectangular body suspended in mid-air seemed to feel the attack, and there were many words on its body, and they blocked the sword light one after another.
The sword light only cut halfway before completely disappearing.
This magic weapon is the same as Yun Chun's Seven Treasures Exquisite Tower. It is the top defensive magic weapon.
However, the Seven Treasures Exquisite Tower is pure defense, this is smart defense.
These damn young masters indeed have heaven-defying defense magic weapons.
Normally, Zhang Yang would definitely not waste his energy trying to break the formation, but when he thought that Luosheng had ended up like this because of this guy, and he was still shouting crazily inside, he couldn't suppress the anger in his heart.
"What, are you scared?"
Seeing that Zhang Yang didn't take action, Luo Ziyun continued to provoke him, "Weren't you crazy just now? Did you want to kill me? That's all you have?"
Zhang Yang's eyes fell on the layers of floating cubes. When attacked, these cubes would move quickly to block the sword's path.
What if - they can't move, or move slower?
"Bing'er, go in and freeze the formation."
Bing Ling took the order and escaped into the formation. He only entered a very shallow place before he was forced back by a powerful force and could not go any further.
"Master, it can only go so deep."
"That's enough, Frozen."
A torrential cold air surged from Bing Ling's body, and the surrounding space froze, instantly freezing the surrounding square body.
"It's useless."
Luo Ziyun sneered and started to drive the formation.
The frozen cube began to move, and the thick ice was crushed instantly, turning into countless ice shards, falling from the sky.
"Who said it's useless?"
Zhang Yang snorted coldly and used the windmill to cut wildly.
Although the cube could crush the ice, it could not keep up with the speed of the windmill. Under the crazy cutting of the swastika seal, a hole was slowly opened in the formation, and Zhang Yang slowly penetrated in.
"You came in here looking for death."
Instead of being afraid, Luo Ziyun was even more happy - this Liuhe Rubik's Cube was not only a defensive magic weapon, but also an offensive magic weapon.
Countless small cubes attacked Zhang Yang with powerful pressure.
This is the moment that Zhang Yang has been waiting for. Whether it is a person or a magic weapon, when attacking, the defense is at its weakest.
He used the Ice and Fire Twin Dragons, and the power exploded in the formation was many times stronger than outside the formation.
Countless squares were blown away, and a gap was opened in the formation.
Luo Ziyun's expression changed greatly, and he recalled that the person who sent the magic weapon said that if the opponent is too powerful, he must defend and not rush forward.
I made a big mistake.
He quickly recalled the cube and wanted to remedy the situation.
Zhang Yang slapped the spirit insect bag, and hundreds of six-winged demon insects flew out, taking advantage of every opportunity and infiltrating into the formation.
Luo Ziyun didn't pay attention to these spirit insects at all, he was focused on Zhang Yang. In his opinion, these spirit insects were nothing to be afraid of.
Little did he know, he made another big mistake.
"Finally in place, puke."
The six-winged demonic insects that penetrated into the formation spit out beads one after another.
Each Buddhist bead lights up in the array, giving birth to the appearance of the Dharma.
"Damn it."
Luo Ziyun knew it was too late and quickly controlled the formation.
Liuhe Rubik's Cube Formation vs. Buddha Formation.
Both of them are large formations at a heaven-defying level. They penetrate and set up formations in their respective spaces. This battle is about whose formation is more powerful and whose foundation is stronger.
